findings.current: They say S-rank Hunters and ordinary Hunters alone have more than 100,000 people participating.
findings.defect: The draft both groups the S-rank Hunters into the figure and changes exactly 100,000 ordinary Hunters to more than 100,000 total participants.
findings.rationale: The particle 만 applies to 일반 헌터: the ordinary Hunters alone number 100,000, in addition to the S-rank Hunters.
findings.replacement: They say S-rank Hunters are fighting alongside 100,000 ordinary Hunters.
findings.source: S급 헌터들에 일반 헌터만 10만 명 참전했다는데 뭐가 그리 걱정임.

findings.current: I was discharged last year, so why does my canteen still taste like Normandy water?
findings.defect: The causal “so” is absent from the source, and the water—not the canteen itself—has the alleged Normandy taste.
findings.rationale: The line jokes that the military canteen and its water seemed impossibly ancient; 전역했는데 is contrastive here.
findings.replacement: I got out last year, but why did the water in my canteen still taste like it came from Normandy?
findings.source: 작년에 전역했는데 왜 수통에서 아직도 노르망디 물맛이 나냐.

findings.current: No. That’s just because it’s all in English and no one understands what it says. I’m running it through Gargle Translator right now.
findings.defect: The draft changes the commenter’s first-person lack of understanding into a claim that no one understands the announcement.
findings.rationale: The omitted subject of 몰라서 is the speaker, as confirmed by their immediately saying they are running the text through a translator.
findings.replacement: No. That’s just because it’s all in English and I don’t understand what it says. I’m running it through Gargle Translator right now.
findings.source: 아니. 그냥 죄다 영어라 뭔 소린지 몰라서 그런 건데. 지금 가글 번역기 돌리고 있음.

findings.current: Practically speaking, most of the monsters we’re fighting right now are undead resurrected by the Arch Lich.
findings.defect: The added “we’re” incorrectly casts the forum commenter and readers as combatants.
findings.rationale: 현재 싸우는 modifies the monsters themselves and does not specify that the commenter is fighting them.
findings.replacement: Practically speaking, most of the monsters fighting right now are undead resurrected by the Arch Lich.
findings.source: 사실상 현재 싸우는 몬스터들 대부분은 아크 리치가 부활시킨 언데드라고 해야 맞다.

findings.current: Shut your mouth and pull down the shutters. Today is the Lady of the House’s memorial day…….
findings.defect: The literal rendering preserves the words but loses the Korean internet joke connecting intense national pride with calling a tavern proprietress for celebratory drinks.
findings.rationale: The line is a punchline to the sudden burst of national pride and is not intelligible from the literal title alone.
findings.replacement:
Shut your mouth and pull down the shutters. Today is the Lady of the House’s memorial day….[^1]

[^1]: Korean netizens traditionally call for a tavern proprietress and drinks when celebrating a surge of national pride; the speaker jokes that the tavern is closed because she is dead.
findings.source: 입 다물고 셔터 내려라. 오늘 주모 제삿날이다…….

findings.current: The battlefield where a fierce battle was about to break out was chaotic.
findings.defect: “Chaotic” implies that disorder or combat is already underway, while the source says the battlefield is crowded before the imminent battle.
findings.rationale: 혼잡했다 describes congestion from the gathered forces, and 곧 벌어질 explicitly places the battle in the immediate future.
findings.replacement: The battlefield where a fierce battle would soon erupt was crowded.
findings.source: 곧 치열한 전투가 벌어질 전장은 혼잡했다.

findings.current: The always immaculate Team Leader Choi was nowhere to be seen.
findings.defect: The draft says Team Leader Choi himself is absent even though he is standing beside Jin; the source says his formerly immaculate appearance is gone.
findings.rationale: 모습 refers to his appearance in context, as the next sentence describes him standing there covered in blood and dust.
findings.replacement: There was no trace left of Team Leader Choi’s usually immaculate appearance.
findings.source: 항상 말끔하던 최 팀장의 모습은 더 이상 찾아볼 수 없다.

findings.current: There were more than a thousand of them.
findings.defect: The draft changes an approximate quantity into a strict lower bound.
findings.rationale: 천여 명 means approximately one thousand people, not necessarily more than one thousand.
findings.replacement: There were roughly a thousand of them.

summary: The draft contains two consequential quantity errors, several altered subjects or scene conditions, and one culturally specific punchline that needs clarification.
